summary: This 8-K filed by 1606 Corp. reports an addendum to an existing promissory note with its former CEO, extending maturity to December 31, 2026, and easing conversion terms to a 50% discount to the closing bid price, subject to a 9.99% beneficial ownership cap. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or forced management change is involved. The board approved by unanimous written consent; no advisor is named. The note conversion mechanics and regulatory clock are standard. This is a routine debt modification, not a special situation. What to watch: potential dilution from conversions if holder elects to convert.
